997-2317-6664-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

1479-2841-3897-6517.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-6517.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

339-677-1753-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3755-4871-5220-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3755-4871-5220-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-4247-5434-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

997-1981-2415-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-5468.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

560-3967-4550-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-3967-4550-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Repeat.

876-6479-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Rainveil Rejuvenator.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Rainveil Rejuvenator from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.
876-6479-7070.notes: You can get infinite mana if you control a static effect that'll boost Rainveil Rejuvenator's power by 1 or more. This can include anthem effects or equipment like Shuko.

206-1368-2033-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
206-1368-2033-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

364-2450-4050-7639.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Arcane Melee.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

112-6747-7426.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
112-6747-7426.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Sami, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1170-2054-2440-7528.description:
Cast the copy of Awaken the Ages from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Strife Scholar, which enters prepared.
When Strife Scholar enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
When the tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers for each of them, adding a total of at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {R} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding nine {C}.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 7 any number of times.

5078-6766-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

5331-5929-7082.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}. When it enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
When the Treasure enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token which enters as a Pirate due to Leyline of Transformation.
When the Ally enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
Repeat from step 2.
5331-5929-7082.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop in step 2. This must be stopped at some point or the game ends in a draw.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7154.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

436-3734-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phyrexian Metamorph dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Phyrexian Metamorph onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

3750-7016-7020.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Firebending Student.
3750-7016-7020.description:
Declare Firebending Student as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ozai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1856-5641-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1856-5641-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing Doom Weaver and the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

5342-6765.easyPrerequisites: A nonland permanent has left the battlefield this turn, or a spell has been warped this turn.
5342-6765.description: Declare Alpharael as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing the defending player to lose at least their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz

1170-3389-5954-6751-6763.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-2043-4715-4893.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin

2353-6574.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-6574.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Kefka triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1548-2921-3719-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Port Razer, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Port Razer or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1548-2921-3719-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Port Raazer as attackers, triggering Luxurious Locomotive, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

3129-3875-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3129-3875-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3129-3875-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1742-2793-3743-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
851-1742-2793-3743-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1558-4076-4231.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-4076-4231.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, two Clue tokens and two Food tokens, and causing the defending player to lose at least 2 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1233-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-4478.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

944-1594-4489.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that has Morph or Megamorph.
944-1594-4489.description:
Cast the creature using its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0}, putting it face-down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face down creature face up, allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

1804-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
1804-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Sigil of Distinction by paying {0}.
Sigil of Distinction enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Sigil of Distinction from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1953-2105-5134.description:
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying {U}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
